claim: Cotton House Hotel occupies the 19th-century former headquarters of Barcelona's Cotton Producers' Guild in the Eixample, five minutes from Passeig de Gracia, with 83 rooms, a rooftop pool, library bar and a bespoke tailoring workshop.
quote: Cotton House offers 83 rooms, five suites, one-of-a-kind spaces such as the Library and L'Atelier, a terrace with lush vegetation, the Batuar Restaurant, a rooftop pool for guests only, a spa room, concierge service and a bespoke tailoring workshop.

claim: Ohla Eixample (and sister Ohla Barcelona) is a design-led boutique in the Eixample that earned a MICHELIN Key for design and guest experience, with Ohla Barcelona home to the MICHELIN-starred Caelis by chef Romain Fornell.
quote: Ohla Eixample has been awarded a MICHELIN Key, recognising excellence in hospitality, design, and the overall guest experience. At Ohla Barcelona, French chef Romain Fornell leads the acclaimed MICHELIN-starred restaurant Caelis.

claim: Barcelona MICHELIN Key holders include Mercer Hotel Barcelona, Serras Barcelona, Almanac Barcelona, Monument Hotel, Wittmore Hotel and Ohla Eixample, spanning historic conversions and design boutiques.
quote: Barcelona hotels include: Mandarin Oriental Barcelona, ABaC Restaurant & Hotel, Alma Barcelona, Almanac Barcelona, Antiga Casa Buenavista... Mercer Hotel Barcelona, Monument Hotel, Ohla Eixample, Serras Barcelona, Seventy Barcelona, Soho House Barcelona, The One Barcelona, Wittmore Hotel Barcelona

claim: Hotel Unico Madrid is a 44-room boutique in a grand old palace on Salamanca's Golden Mile with marble mosaics and chandeliers, home to the two-MICHELIN-starred Ramon Freixa restaurant, from about EUR 364 per night in 2026.
quote: Hotel Unico occupies a grand old palace on the city's exclusive Golden Mile featuring marble mosaics, swirling red sculptures and elaborate chandeliers... two-Michelin-starred restaurant helmed by renowned chef Ramon Freixa... From EUR364.50 per night

claim: Gran Melia Palacio de los Duques is a converted 19th-century Madrid palace with a rooftop pool facing the Royal Palace and a Roman-inspired caldarium spa, while CoolRooms Palacio de Atocha layers bold contemporary design into an 1852 palace.
quote: Gran Melia Palacio de los Duques - A grand 19th-century palace converted into the Melia group's flagship, with a rooftop pool facing the Royal Palace... CoolRooms Palacio de Atocha - A richly restored 1852 palace layered with bold contemporary design.

claim: Hotel Urso, a Small Luxury Hotel of the World, occupies a meticulously restored early-20th-century palace in central Madrid, blending contemporary style with historic charm.
quote: Hotel Urso - A Small Luxury Hotel of the World, blends contemporary style with historic charm in the heart of Madrid. Housed in a meticulously restored early 20th-century palace

claim: Verride Palacio Santa Catarina is a 19-room conversion of a 1750 noble palace in Lisbon's Chiado, retaining 18th-century azulejos, carved wooden ceilings and imported chandeliers with a 360-degree rooftop over the Tagus, from roughly EUR 550 per night.
quote: This splendid old palace in the blossoming Chiado district dates back to the year 1750... 19 stylish rooms... details like imported chandeliers from European palaces, silk-lined walls... Rates start from $570... rooms start from around EUR550 per night

claim: Locke de Santa Joana, the brand's first Portugal opening and largest Locke, occupies a former 17th-century Lisbon convent with 370 rooms, preserving original azulejos, vaulted ceilings and stone staircases amid contemporary design.
quote: Locke de Santa Joana - Set in a former 17th-century convent - now home to 370 rooms and apartments... preserved architectural features such as original azulejos, vaulted ceilings, and stone staircases - with contemporary design in soft, natural tones.

claim: Lisbon MICHELIN Key hotels include Sublime Lisboa, Bairro Alto Hotel, Santiago de Alfama, The One Palacio da Anunciada and Palacio Ludovice Wine Experience Hotel, most set within historic buildings retaining Portugal's past.
quote: Lisbon hotels include: Art Legacy Hotel Baixa-Chiado, Bairro Alto Hotel, Brown's Avenue Hotel, Palacio Ludovice Wine Experience Hotel, Santiago de Alfama - Boutique Hotel, Sublime Lisboa, The One Palacio da Anunciada, and Pousada de Lisboa, Praca do Comercio.

claim: Torel Palace Porto is a 24-room luxury boutique in the 1861 Romantic-style Palacete Campos Navarro reimagined by designer Isabel Sa Nogueira, with rooms inspired by Portuguese literature and the MICHELIN-starred BLIND restaurant, rates roughly USD 115-459.
quote: The palace dates from 1861... built by a wealthy local family in the then-current Romantic style... 24 rooms and suites, as well as 18 unique apartments, all inspired by Portuguese literature... MICHELIN-starred BLIND restaurant led by Chef Vitor Matos.

claim: Pestana Vintage Porto occupies a set of UNESCO-listed 18th-century buildings in ochre, brick-red and stone tones on Porto's Ribeira waterfront, offering atmospheric stays at relatively reasonable prices.
quote: Pestana Vintage Porto occupies a set of 18th-century buildings deemed culturally significant by UNESCO, with uniformly charming exteriors featuring walls in a warm range of ochres, brick reds, and soft stone... unbeatable location by Porto's atmospheric waterfront.

claim: Casa do Conto in Porto's Cedofeita neighbourhood is a 19th-century townhouse destroyed by fire and rebuilt as a striking modernist design hotel, while Casa da Companhia on Ribeira pairs 18th-century stone columns and wrought-iron facade with a spa.
quote: Casa do Conto is a striking boutique hotel in Porto's Cedofeita neighborhood, originally a 19th-century townhouse destroyed by fire that has been rebuilt as a stunning example of modernist architecture... Casa da Companhia Hotel & Spa... much 18th-century grandeur, magisterial stone columns, and wrought iron facade.

claim: Hotel Ritz Madrid, A Belmond Hotel reopened after a three-year renovation as a 1910 Alphonsine palace of gilded ballrooms and stained glass, while Madrid's design scene also spans avant-garde Malasana retreats.
quote: Hotel Ritz Madrid - A Belmond Hotel - Reopened after a magnificent three-year renovation... a 1910 Alphonsine fantasy of gilded ballrooms, stained glass, and the most beautiful outdoor terrace in Madrid overlooking the Prado.
